hints: Since $B(-3, 2)$ and $C(5, 2)$ lie on the horizontal line $y = 2$, the base length is $BC = 5 - (-3) = 8$.
The perpendicular height is the vertical distance from $A(1, 8)$ down to $y = 2$, giving $h = 8 - 2 = 6$.
walkthrough:
A horizontal base makes the vertical coordinate difference the height.
Find the horizontal base length $BC$ and the perpendicular height from $A$:
$$BC = |5 - (-3)| = 8$$
$$\text{Height } h = |8 - 2| = 6$$
